purpose: Central immutable registry for validation runs that verify the historical property fixture governance status chain.
registry_rules: Each completed history-validation run receives one immutable entry.
Run identity, contract, date, scope and result must be preserved.
A later run creates a new entry and does not overwrite an earlier run.
Technical governance validation remains separate from legal verification and publication.
guardrails: This registry records technical validation only.
It does not establish Irish property-law correctness.
It does not represent live official-record retrieval.
